notes:
- Improved clipboard reliability when copying and pasting files and text in Remote Desktop sessions.

- Added real-time progress indicators and native Windows notifications for Remote Desktop file and large-text clipboard transfers.

- Added a 'Type saved password' option in the Remote Desktop Send Keys menu to securely type connection credentials into remote lock screens, login prompts, and UAC dialogs with device verification.

- Added App Lock to protect Remote Client using device authentication (Windows Hello / Touch ID) on startup, computer lock, idle inactivity timeouts, or manual lock, while keeping active sessions connected in the background.

- Added a built-in SFTP file browser for both Linux and Windows hosts, supporting directory navigation, uploads, downloads, file creation, renaming, and deletions.
